edges.label: Two Directors of Central Intelligence corresponded with him in office
edges.note: Two Directors of Central Intelligence corresponded with him in office, Dulles in January 1958 on avoiding duplication between CIA and Army research programmes and McCone in March 1962 on the Limited-War Mission symposium.

edges.label: Addressed at the Department of the Army, Washington 25, D. C.
